---
title: Analyzing Economic Data
subtitle: "ECON 3030 | Spring 2027"
---

California State University, Bakersfield

Learn to ask a question, organize a dataset, make a chart, and explain what the evidence supports. This course offers an accessible introduction to analyzing and visualizing real-world data using spreadsheets and Python. **No prior programming experience is required.**

[View the weekly schedule](schedule.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .mt-3 .mb-4}

## How we learn

Start with a lecture, work through guided practice, then apply your skills in a separate graded lab. We begin with Excel. For Python, we use Google Colab in the browser, with Polars for tables and Altair for charts.

This website brings together slides, notebooks, and datasets. Use **Canvas** for the official syllabus, policies, assignments, submissions, deadlines, announcements, grades, and feedback.

The site is an initial preview. Available materials are listed on the schedule; further materials will be added as they are ready.
